expectedToken.description: Use data.token from the latest readRange of the same sheet and address; valid only in this Task and while its observed state is unchanged.

items.description: Invariant formula with same-sheet A1 references; supported functions: ABS, AND, AVERAGE, CONCATENATE, COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, COUNTIF, COUNTIFS, DATE, DAY, FIND, HLOOKUP, IF, IFERROR, INDEX, LEFT, LEN, LOWER, MATCH, MAX, MID, MIN, MONTH, NOT, OR, RIGHT, ROUND, ROUNDDOWN, ROUNDUP, SEARCH, SUBSTITUTE, SUM, SUMIF, SUMIFS, TEXT, TRIM, UPPER, VALUE, VLOOKUP, YEAR. No external workbook or cross-sheet references.
